10 years ago: 30-yr mortgage rate was 3.4% & median existing home price in the US was $243k

Today: 30-yr mortgage rate is 6.7% & median existing home price is $434k

Result: $38k increase in down payment (assume 20% down) & 160% increase in monthly payment (from $862 to $2,240)

items.title: RT by @charliebilello: RT by @charliebilello: You don't rebuild the American cattle herd by importing foreign beef and intentionally selling it below the market price American ranchers receive. That's exactly the opposite of the incentive structure one would use to encourage domestic supply growth. More supply + below-market foreign competition → lower domestic beef prices → lower cattle prices → weaker margins/incentives for American ranchers → less domestic supply

items.content:
Treasury announced a bigger “debt buyback” this week.

What happened next?

Bitcoin +19%. Gold +6%. Dollar -1%.

What this means:
More deficits. More debt. More money printing.

Washington won’t get its fiscal house in order, so investors are buying alternatives to the Dollar.Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello)The Treasury Department is calling this a “debt buyback.”

But they’re not reducing the debt.

They’re running huge deficits, buying back old bonds, and issuing even more new ones.

This is debt reshuffling, not debt reduction.—  https://x.com/charliebilello/status/2090074621865308482 
— Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello) Aug 22, 2026
